thread:
incbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGER — Dedicated pool 'zephyr-pool' node gpu-42 reported repeated ECC/NVLINK errors and BMC reset, customer impact: Zephyr Analytics (vpc-zephyr) seeing 503s and timeouts. Pager: @ben_oncall

ben_oncall: I'm on pager. Triage in progress, putting node into drain and isolating tenant. Will post timeline.

alice_sre: Quick findings: GPU3 memory ECC spikes ~4187654287 then kernel oops and BMC watchdog reset at 4187654305. Trace snippet:
```
[4187654287.124] nvlink: ECC corrected errors: gpu3: count=128
[4187654305.998] kernel: nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU halted, scheduling reset
[4187654306.012] bmc: watchdog: rebooting system
```

eli_infra: Cloud provider shows a spot preemption signal around 4187654298 for that instance (preempt-reason: host-hardware-fault). Possibly dual issue: underlying host flapped and card degraded.

ben_oncall: Executing isolation now: `redwoodctl pool node drain --pool zephyr-pool --node gpu-42 --reason "ECC+BMC_RESET" --async`

ben_oncall: Routing note — tenant vpc-zephyr has live traffic pinned to gpu-42 for some heavy batch jobs. I'm triggering failover to warm-fallback pool: `redwoodctl route update --tenant vpc-zephyr --target pool:zephyr-warm --weight 100`

carla_customer_success: Pinged Zephyr ops (zephyr-ops@zephyranalytics). They confirm user-facing inference errors. Asked for a customer-friendly summary and ETA.

dave_pm: What's ETA for node replacement / RMA? Also need to check SLO/credits exposure.

harry_hw: Hardware team — request RMA. Preliminary: NVLink lane and thermal traces point to a failing GPU module, we should replace node. ETA to swap & validate: ~3h onsite or 30-45m if cloud hot-replace available.

alice_sre: For immediate mitigation: current plan = isolate node, reroute tenant to warm pool, keep small canary traffic (5%) on old node for logs until safe. Monitoring checks: token-level error rate, 99th latency, and model convergence sanity.

ben_oncall: Incident status -> MITIGATING (incbot updated). Rolling update to routing in progress, will monitor for 10m.

incbot: Incident 3187654321 status changed: MITIGATING. Acknowledged by ben_oncall.

eli_infra: Also observed host reported unclean shutdown logs — filing cloud support ticket #CS-9921 for host health and potential host-level replacement to avoid recurrence.

ben_oncall: Customer update draft: "We've isolated the affected node and routed your traffic to a warm fallback pool. We're replacing the faulty GPU node and expect full restoration within ~3 hours; there may be degraded throughput for a short window during the cutover. We're tracking this as SEV2 and will follow up once RMA completes." Any edits?

carla_customer_success: Sent to customer, added note about temporary request limits to reduce queue depth. Customer acknowledged and requested updates every 30m.

harry_hw: Kicked off RMA ticket with partner (RMA-55678). Preparing replacement image; will coordinate validation run and then instruct `redwoodctl pool node replace --pool zephyr-pool --old gpu-42 --new gpu-77` when hardware is ready.

ben_oncall: Monitoring after reroute: error rate dropped 92%, 99th latency back to baseline for most routes. Marking this thread for handoff to hardware once replacement begins. On-call handoff planned to night-shift SRE at 4187654700.

alice_sre: Save snapshots: /var/log/nvidia/gpu3/error.log and telemetry snapshot uploaded to s3://incidents/4187654321/gpu3-snaps.tar.gz for later postmortem.

ben_oncall: Handoff: tagging incident to #hardware and assigning to harry_hw for RMA + validation. Closing active mitigation loop here; will reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
